content: Actual recorded RGB, measured Kinect depth colour display and saved OpenFusion CUDA TSDF raycasts. No generated scene frames or new reconstruction. Palette quantization and spatial area scaling reduce GIF size.

excerpt.selection: FFmpeg fps=6 selects actual source frames, without temporal interpolation; all three source panels retained.

display_scope: Saved-output playback. GIF speed is not a reconstruction performance measurement. Motion-capture errors are offline camera trajectory comparisons, not surface error. Source frame/time/error captions remain visible; unmatched mocap timestamps remain labeled unavailable.

caption_adjustment.reason: Source video footer says 30 fps; the GIF plays at 6 fps. Only that footer label is replaced.

encoding.tool: ffmpeg version 8.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
encoding.caption_overlay_generation: Pillow RGBA 800x300 transparent canvas; draw rectangle (596,255)-(799,269) in (16,24,32,255); Arial.ttf size9 text at (604,258), 6 fps GIF · saved output, colour (184,203,221,255).
encoding.gif_comment: Inserted a GIF comment extension with dataset attribution, license URLs and saved-playback scope after the global colour table; no scene pixel changes.

attribution.citation: J. Sturm, N. Engelhard, F. Endres, W. Burgard and D. Cremers, A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems, IROS 2012.

checks.visual_review: First frame and four-frame contact sheet; RGB/depth/raycast objects, source captions and credits checked at native size.
